name: updateLocationField
description: Changes an extra location field's name, type, or whether it must be filled in.

label.description: The current name of the field to change.

newLabel.description: The field's new name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newType.description: What the field holds from now on. Text and rich text are for text content fields only. Leave it out to keep the current type.

required.description: Whether people must fill the field in. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

allowCustomLabel.description: Whether people can give the field their own label. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

callback.description: Runs when the field is changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, such as no field having that name.

result.description: The field as it is now.

section.description: Where the field shows: quick actions or text content.

type.description: What the field holds, such as an email, a phone number or text.

required.description: Whether people must fill it in.

allowCustomLabel.description: Whether people can give it their own label.
